projects.title: The last light
projects.subtitle: A lighthouse keeper. An impossible signal. One last night before the sea comes in.

nodes.title: The night the sea goes silent
nodes.opening: The lighthouse receives a distress signal from a ship that sank twenty years ago.
nodes.closing: The light answers. For the first time, the island answers with it.

nodes.title: Who is sending the signal?
nodes.opening: The voice on the radio knows Mara’s childhood nickname.
nodes.closing: It is a warning sent by the people her father left behind.

nodes.title: A stranger at the door
nodes.opening: Eli arrives soaked through, carrying a radio that should not work.
nodes.prose:
Three knocks. Then a fourth, softer one.

Mara left the kettle where it was. Nobody on the island knocked four times. Nobody on the island would have come out in this weather at all.

Behind the door, someone said her name.

nodes.title: Mara learns to let someone stay
nodes.opening: Mara believes keeping everyone at a distance is how she keeps them safe.
nodes.closing: She hands Eli the spare key. This time, she leaves both cups on the table.

nodes.title: The spare key
nodes.opening: The lamp fails. Mara has to ask Eli to climb the tower with her.

characters.name: Mara Venn
characters.notes: She notices what people do with their hands. Never what they say about themselves.

blocks.text: Depending on people gives them power over you
Never leave someone out in the storm
Sets two cups on the table, then puts one away
Reads the sea by the sound of it
blocks.detail: Cannot read a storm that has already gone quiet.

block.text: Letting someone help is a choice, not a surrender

changes.reason: Eli stays when leaving would be easier.

block.text: Leaves two cups on the table

changes.reason: A small habit makes the change visible.

characters.name: Eli Ash
characters.identity: A stranger with a familiar story

blocks.text: Get a message to the mainland
Knows why the old light went dark
Says the hard thing as if it were obvious

characters.name: June Venn
characters.identity: Mara’s sister · voice on the radio

blocks.text: Asks a second time, more gently

world.name: The North Light
world.notes: A working lighthouse on an island that is slowly losing its shore. Three hundred and seventeen steps. One spare key.

world.name: The sea remembers
world.notes: On a windless night, a radio can pick up what the water has kept.

connections.label: Suspicion → earned trust
connections.notes: He needs shelter. She needs a reason to open the door.

connections.label: Love at a distance
connections.notes: June calls every evening. Mara always lets it ring twice.
